character_sheet: A giant crab at one of three sizes: a six-block body (a shell top and bottom, two side plates, a rear block and a face block), two two-piece eyestalks angled outward, two mouthparts, two five-piece claw arms ending in a hinged pincer, and eight three-segment legs drawn from three leg parts (ModelCrab.java:47-71; 25 classic parts on a 256x512 sheet, 46 bones in the rig). The 1.7.10 model drew those three leg parts eight times at eight poses - four legs a side, front to back - so the rig carries twenty-four leg bones drawn from the three parts (`leg1__i0`..`leg1__i7`, `leg2__i0`.., `leg3__i0`..: the converter's render_instances form, draws 0-3 the left side at z 0 / 10 / 20 / 30, draws 4-7 the right); the port's renderToBuffer re-poses and draws the three parts at each of the eight poses (ModelCrab.java:258-344, the draw fix of the Crab's slice T2d, 2026-09-14: ANIM-025 closed), so the game draws all eight legs. It is a hostile scavenger scaled 0.25, 0.5 or 1.0 at spawn (0.35 from a spawner; Crab.java:147-159) with its stats, speed, reach, knockback, XP and hitbox scaled with it (:161-186, :201-229, :130-137): 250 x scale HP, 24 x scale damage, 16 + 2 x scale armour. Every fifth tick it looks 16 blocks for a non-creative player, any monster, a lizard, a rubber ducky, a villager, a girlfriend, a boyfriend or an attackable non-mob (:365-395), raises the synched attacking flag within 6 blocks plus half the prey's width (scaled, :307-309), swings on a 40 percent roll (:311-321, doHurtTarget :212-229 with knockback) and clears the flag when no target is found (:326). It seeks water when dry and dries out without it (:277-290), heals in water (:330-335), ignores cactus and its own kind, takes a hit only every 8 ticks and turns on a mob that hits it (:231-248); it spawns above y 50 by day, rarely in the Crystal dimension (:443-456). Read it as a sidling crab: legs scuttling, eyestalks and mouthparts twitching - faster and wider when it hunts - claws waving, then snapping.
size_notes: Drawn at x getCrabScale() of the rig - 0.25, 0.35, 0.5 or 1.0 (CrabRenderer.java:37-38; Crab.java:118-120) - on a 256x512 sheet (ModelCrab.java:178); the hitbox is 2.5 x scale wide and 3.5 x scale tall (Crab.java:130-137; ModEntities.java:66-70); shadow 0.99, never scaled (CrabRenderer.java:27).

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: +-pi/2 rad rest (the legs turned square to the body), then pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) x the walking speed at 1.7, no threshold; the eight legs alternate the sign pair by pair (front and third one way, second and rear the other, the right side mirrored)
groups.plain: the eight legs scuttle fore and aft about the vertical with the stride, the pairs alternating: on each side the front and third legs swing one way while the second and rear swing the other, and the right side mirrors the left
groups.math: a = cos(ageInTicks * 1.7) * pi * 0.15 * limbSwingAmount; each leg's three segments share the yaw: the left legs (x 36) at z 0 / 10 / 20 / 30 take yRot = -pi/2 + a, -pi/2 - a, -pi/2 + a, -pi/2 - a (bones __i0..__i3), the right legs (x -36) the negatives pi/2 - a, pi/2 + a, pi/2 - a, pi/2 + a (__i4..__i7) - the eight poses of ModelCrab.java:258-344, one bone each; the pitch is each segment's own
groups.omega_note: the phase is ageInTicks x 1.7 (no wingspeed - the ModelCrab(1.0f) argument is unused, CrabRenderer.java:17-18): the natural period is 2 pi / 1.7 = 3.7 ticks

groups.name: eyes
groups.amplitude: calm: pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) at four rates - left pitch 0.35, left roll 0.25 (around +0.54), right pitch 0.3, right roll 0.45 (around -0.54); attacking: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) at 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.55
groups.plain: the two eyestalks wobble on their own, each piece pair together - a small slow wobble at rest, twice as wide and faster when it hunts
groups.math: calm: Leye1/2.xRot = cos(t * 0.35) * pi * 0.05; Leye1/2.zRot = 0.54 + cos(t * 0.25) * pi * 0.05; Reye1/2.xRot = cos(t * 0.3) * pi * 0.05; Reye1/2.zRot = -0.54 + cos(t * 0.45) * pi * 0.05; attacking: the same at 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.55 and pi x 0.1
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm (Crab.java:309 raises it, :326 clears it)
groups.omega_note: four rates in one group: the omega here is the left pitch's 0.35 (period 18 ticks); the others 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.45 calm and 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.55 attacking - author the wobble at 0.35 with the other three offset

groups.name: mouth
groups.amplitude: -0.72 / +0.72 rad rests, then calm: pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) at 0.25; attacking: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) at 0.45 - the two mouthparts mirrored
groups.plain: the mouthparts work open and shut together, gently at rest and chewing hard when it hunts
groups.math: calm: Lmouth.yRot = -0.72 + cos(t * 0.25) * pi * 0.05; Rmouth.yRot = 0.72 - the same; attacking: cos(t * 0.45) * pi * 0.15
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm (Crab.java:309, :326)
groups.omega_note: the calm phase is ageInTicks x 0.25: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.25 = 25.1 ticks; attacking 2 pi / 0.45 = 14 ticks

groups.name: claws
groups.amplitude: rests -0.453 / -0.349 / +0.384 rad (left hand base, fixed pincer, moving pincer; the right the negatives), then calm: left pi x 0.03 = 0.094 rad (5 deg) at 0.15, right pi x 0.02 = 0.063 rad (4 deg) at 0.13; attacking: left pi x 0.13 = 0.408 rad (23 deg) at 0.35, right pi x 0.12 = 0.377 rad (22 deg) at 0.43 - the moving pincer takes the negative, so the claw opens and shuts
groups.plain: each claw's hand and fixed pincer swing together while the moving pincer swings the other way - a slow open-and-shut at rest, a fast wide snapping when it hunts, the two claws on slightly different beats
groups.math: calm: nL = cos(t * 0.15) * pi * 0.03, nR = cos(t * 0.13) * pi * 0.02; attacking: nL = cos(t * 0.35) * pi * 0.13, nR = cos(t * 0.43) * pi * 0.12; Lclaw3.yRot = -0.453 + nL; Lclaw4.yRot = -0.349 + nL; Lclaw5.yRot = 0.384 - nL; Rclaw3.yRot = 0.453 + nR; Rclaw4.yRot = 0.349 + nR; Rclaw5.yRot = -0.384 - nR
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm (Crab.java:309, :326)
groups.omega_note: the calm phase is ageInTicks x 0.15 (left) / 0.13 (right): the natural periods are 41.9 / 48.3 ticks; attacking 0.35 / 0.43 - 18 / 14.6 ticks; the omega here is the left claw's calm rate

behaviour: The legs (ModelCrab.java:258-344): the cosine of the age x 1.7, x pi x 0.15, x the walking speed (27 degrees at full speed every 3.7 ticks, no threshold) is added to or subtracted from a +-pi/2 rest on the three leg parts, which the code positions and poses eight times in a row - four on the left side (x = +36, the model's +x side, vanilla's left_arm convention) at z = 0, 10, 20, 30 with alternating sign, four on the right (x = -36) negated. The 1.7.10 original rendered the parts at each pose, and the rig carries every one: twenty-four leg bones, one per part per pose (`leg1__i0`..`leg3__i7`), so the artist animates eight three-segment legs. Since the Crab's slice (T2d, 2026-09-14) the port's renderToBuffer re-poses and draws the parts at each of the eight poses (ModelCrab.java:258-344), so the game draws all eight legs (ANIM-025 closed).

Everything else branches on the synched attacking flag (:218-248). Calm: the eyestalks wobble 9 degrees - the left pitching at 0.35 and rolling at 0.25 around +0.54 rad, the right pitching at 0.3 and rolling at 0.45 around -0.54; the mouthparts work 9 degrees at 0.25 around +-0.72; the claws open and shut 5 (left, at 0.15) and 4 (right, at 0.13) degrees around their rests. Attacking: the eyes 18 degrees at 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.55, the mouth 27 degrees at 0.45, the claws 23 (left, at 0.35) and 22 (right, at 0.43) degrees - every rhythm faster and two to five times wider.

Each claw is five flat bones: the shoulder and arm pieces (Lclaw1, Lclaw2 and the right pair) never move; the hand base and fixed pincer take the wave and the moving pincer its negative, so the claw snaps about the hand. The shell blocks, side plates, rear and face blocks never move; nothing reads the look (netHeadYaw unused), so the LookAtPlayerGoal (Crab.java:92) turns nothing visible.

The attacking flag is held: set 1 every fifth think tick while the prey is within reach (Crab.java:307-309) and 0 when no target is found (:326) - a state, so the swing (doHurtTarget :212-229, with a knockback of 1.15 x scale) is transport 1.
The renderer scales the whole rig by the crab's synched size (CrabRenderer.java:37-38): a 0.25 crab is a quarter of the rig, a 1.0 crab the full 5-block-wide monster - author at the rig's scale.

wishlist: the legs: the rig carries the eight legs the 1.7.10 crab drew (twenty-four bones from the three parts) - author all eight; the game draws all eight since the Crab's slice (T2d, 2026-09-14; ANIM-025 closed)
in `walk`: a sideways scuttle - the code swings the legs fore and aft (:261-344) but a crab moves broadside; a lift-and-set of the leg parts with the body rocking sells it
in `attack`: a real claw strike - the code only speeds up the open-and-shut (:240-247); throw one claw forward and close the moving pincer (Lclaw5 / Rclaw5) on the impact frame

keep each claw whole: hand base, fixed pincer and moving pincer share one pivot (the rig's Lclaw3-5 / Rclaw3-5) and the arm pieces (Lclaw1-2 / Rclaw1-2) never move - key the arm pieces too so the claw reaches rather than pivots in place
in `hurt`: a rear-up with both claws raised - it turns on whatever hits it (Crab.java:243-246)
formulas: `ModelCrab.poseFrom` and `ModelCrab.renderToBuffer` (ModelCrab.java:215-249 and :258-368, the eight poses :261-344; orig ModelCrab.java:195-330 `render` (func_78088_a; func_78087_a at :338-340 is a bare super call), the leg poses :199-274, the attacking branch :275-305; no wingspeed - the `new ModelCrab(1.0f)` argument of orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:518 is unused): the leg swing is the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.7, times pi, times 0.15, times the walking speed (up to 27 degrees each way every 3.7 ticks; no threshold); the three leg parts are placed and drawn eight times in a row - four on the left side (x 36, y 3) at z 0, 10, 20 and 30 with a yaw of minus a quarter turn plus the swing, minus a quarter turn minus the swing, plus, minus, then four on the right side (x -36) with each of those yaws negated (orig :199-274; since the Crab's slice T2d the port's renderToBuffer draws them at every pose, ANIM-025 closed) - the rig's twenty-four leg bones, one per part and pose. While the attacking flag is 0 (orig :275-289): the two left eyestalk parts pitch by the cosine of the age times 0.35, times pi, times 0.05 and roll by 0.54 radians plus the cosine of the age times 0.25, times pi, times 0.05; the two right eyestalk parts pitch at 0.3 and roll by -0.54 plus the cosine at 0.45, the same amplitude; the left mouthpart yaws by -0.72 plus the cosine of the age times 0.25, times pi, times 0.05 and the right by 0.72 minus the same; the left claw's hand base and fixed pincer yaw by -0.453 and -0.349 plus the cosine of the age times 0.15, times pi, times 0.03 and its moving pincer by 0.384 minus that; the right claw's by 0.453 and 0.349 plus the cosine of the age times 0.13, times pi, times 0.02 and its moving pincer by -0.384 minus that. While attacking (orig :290-305): the same parts at 0.45 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.55 with pi times 0.1 on the eyes, at 0.45 with pi times 0.15 on the mouths, at 0.35 with pi times 0.13 on the left claw and at 0.43 with pi times 0.12 on the right. The walk position and the head angles play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (CrabGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations: the eight poses land on the clones leg1__i0..7, leg2__i0..7 and leg3__i0..7, one bone per part and pose).
